common_questions.question: What's included in the CloudOps Suite?
common_questions.answer: CloudOps Suite includes three powerful modules: Cloud Monitor Pro for real-time infrastructure monitoring, Cost Optimizer AI for automated cost savings (avg 35% reduction), and Security Command Center for compliance and threat detection. You can purchase modules individually or as a bundled suite for additional savings.

common_questions.question: Can I try before buying?
common_questions.answer: Absolutely! We offer a 14-day free trial for all products with full feature access. No credit card required. After the trial, you can choose the tier that fits your needs or speak with our sales team about custom enterprise solutions.

common_questions.question: Do you offer enterprise discounts?
common_questions.answer: Yes! Enterprise customers purchasing multiple modules or exceeding 100 users typically receive 15-30% volume discounts. We also offer custom pricing for multi-year commitments. Contact our sales team for a personalized quote.

common_questions.question: What's the difference between cloud and on-premise deployment?
common_questions.answer: Our cloud deployment is fully managed, scales automatically, and includes all updates. On-premise deployment (available in Enterprise tiers) gives you complete control, meets strict compliance requirements, and can run in air-gapped environments. Both options include the same features.

common_questions.question: How does the Cost Optimizer AI pricing work?
common_questions.answer: We offer a unique Pay-as-you-save model at 15% of identified savings, so you only pay when you save money. For customers wanting more advanced automation and dedicated support, our Business and Enterprise tiers offer fixed pricing plus a percentage of savings.

common_questions.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my license?
common_questions.answer: Yes, you can change your license tier at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately. Downgrades take effect at the next billing cycle. There are no penalties for changing tiers.

common_questions.question: What integrations are available?
common_questions.answer: We integrate with 500+ tools including AWS, Azure, GCP, Datadog, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce, and more. Enterprise customers can also build custom integrations using our REST APIs and webhooks.

common_questions.question: What kind of support do you provide?
common_questions.answer: Support varies by tier: Starter plans include email support, Professional plans add priority chat support, and Enterprise plans include 24/7 phone support with dedicated account managers and success teams. All plans include access to our documentation and community forums.

common_questions.question: Is there a setup fee?
common_questions.answer: No setup fees for cloud deployments. On-premise Enterprise deployments may include implementation services depending on complexity. We'll provide a detailed quote during the sales process.

common_questions.question: How do I get started?
common_questions.answer: You can start a free trial immediately at techcorp.com/trial or schedule a personalized demo with our team. For enterprise customers, we recommend a discovery call to understand your specific needs and provide a customized solution.
